name: paperbanana-provider-neutral-vlm-call-f47a
instr:
paperbanana cannot durably inspect, store, or replay provider-neutral VLM calls. Add canonical requests, versioned receipts, atomic storage, and offline replay without changing direct generation behavior.

Each receipted attempt through OpenAIVLM, AtlasVLM, AnthropicVLM, BedrockVLM, GeminiVLM, OllamaVLM, LiteLLMVLM, or ClaudeCodeVLM must make exactly one native request and return a receipt. Independently capture each adapter's effective messages or blocks, provider identity, controls, JSON behavior, image evidence, response extraction, native usage, and terminal outcome, excluding credentials and mutable images. Keep image digests and dimensions immutable and serializable. fingerprint(self) must be process-stable and distinguish every effective request value.

Receipts must round-trip every field, deterministically reject unsupported versions, and never present failure or cancellation as success. VLMReceiptStore(root) must atomically commit receipts and validated content-addressed images by fingerprint. load(self, fingerprint) must not expose partial data. Make ReceiptConflictError a RuntimeError for conflicting evidence and ReceiptIntegrityError a RuntimeError for corrupted assets.

ReplayVLMProvider(store, provider, model), a VLMProvider, must return matching successes without provider access, raise ReplayMismatchError as a LookupError for mismatches, and raise ReplayRecordedFailure as a RuntimeError for recorded failures. Preserve generate results, exceptions, request sema
